description: This file defines the 'TablePropertyPanel' class, a Java Swing component that displays detailed properties of a 'Table' object, including its category, name, description, storage info, and log parameters. It provides a GUI panel for viewing table metadata in a software project focused on vehicle tuning or data mapping.
